description: Query of `GET /mgmt/v1/spaces/{space_id}/voice/changes`: long-poll after a cursor.

after.description: The cursor of `voice/states` or of the previous page's `next`.

limit.description: At most this many changes (1–500, default 100).

wait.description: Long-poll up to this many seconds while there is nothing to return (0–30, default 0).

title: MgmtVoiceChangesQuery
